in_marathi.name: Dhatri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Giving
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhatri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhatri is a goddess of giving, associated with fertility and abundance. She is often depicted with a pot of rice or grains, symbolizing her role as a giver and nurturer.
